scope: Snapshot: first prompt on 12 November 2026 through the sketch request on 14 November 2026, 09:25:36 Europe/Warsaw (08:25:36 UTC). 87 user messages and 606 Codex replies/updates. Every visible message is included. Absolute local file paths and technical message identifiers are omitted; question/reply wrappers are presented as readable exchanges. Runtime instructions, tool traffic and hidden reasoning are excluded. Referenced attachments are not embedded; historical links may not be publicly accessible. This is a historical production record: later decisions supersede earlier statements. The current delivery happens after the snapshot cutoff.
original_text_integrity: All 693 visible messages retained. Text differs from the exact private source only by the listed local-path and technical-wrapper removals. No substantive dialogue is summarized.

translations.method: Complete local machine translation with Argos Polish-English 1.9 / OPUS-MT, CTranslate2 int8 beam 4. Technical spans retained. Not a certified or fully human-reviewed translation; the original transcript is authoritative. No message summarized or intentionally omitted.
translations.attribution: Jörg Tiedemann and Santhosh Thottingal (2020), OPUS-MT — Building open translation services for the World. Original model CC BY 4.0 according to packaged README.
translations.editorial_review: All 87 user messages and selected assistant replies reviewed/retranslated by Codex; other assistant messages remain machine translated. Original Polish is authoritative. Question/reply envelopes are rendered as readable exchanges in English.

excluded: System/developer instructions, runtime context injections, hidden reasoning, all tool calls and tool outputs. No other chat was accessed or included.
